messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from last night's incident — putting remediation owners and timelines here so we can track. Root causes: scheduler backpressure + quota exhaustion in eu-west + low soft headroom. Please ack and add if you pick something up.

TJ: Ack. Suggest splitting into: emergency quota backstop, scheduler tuning, and runbook/oncall rotation.

maria: Agreed. Proposed owners: tj -> quota backstop, devon -> scheduler tuning PR & tests, sasha -> runbook + PD checklist. I'll validate rollouts.

devon: I'll open a scheduler PR today. Plan: increase scheduling minReady window for batch nodes to 45s, tighten preemption policy, add soft-cap for tiny pods. Local perf looks OK. PR will include a repro script.

maria: Please add this repro to the PR so QA can run it:
```bash
# synthetic burst similar to incident
kubectl run burst-client --image=busybox --restart=Never -- /bin/sh -c 'for i in $(seq 1 300); do curl -sS http://inference.local/generate >/dev/null & done; wait'
```

devon: added. ETA to merge: EOD tomorrow barring regressions.

ops-bot: INC-3421 created: quota-backstop-eu-west. Assigned to tj. SLA: 72h.

tj: I'll file quota request and spin a short-lived reserved pool (1 A100 equiv) as emergency backstop. Target: 48h. Will post request IDs.

sasha: For the runbook I'll add a step-by-step triage checklist, who-to-ping matrix, and the emergency quota play. Also proposing a weekly 15m capacity triage rotation on Wednesdays.

lee: +1. Can we add PD checklist items so oncall sees the exact toggles (quota, scheduler, fallback model)?

maria: Good idea. sasha, can you wire the PD hook or should I?

sasha: I can wire it. Runbook update & PD checklist by Fri 23:59 PST, and I'll create the calendar recurrence.

tj: Note: quota request needs spike graphs. Use this query to generate them:
```sql
SELECT minute, sum(gpu_seconds) FROM infra.metrics
WHERE cluster = 'eu-west' AND minute >= now() - interval '12 hour'
GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 120;
```

maria: Action recap:
- tj: emergency quota + reserved pool (48h) -> update INC-3421 with IDs
- devon: scheduler PR + perf tests (EOD tomorrow) -> link PR
- sasha: runbook + PD checklist + rotation (Fri) -> link runbook
- maria: validate canary & coordinate with SRE
- lee: help with PD automation and calendar ticket

tj: ack. Also adding a spike alert for eu-west to cut detection time.

devon: I'll add a unit/integration test asserting no starvation under 2x synthetic bursts.

maria: Reconvene in 72h in #incidents to close the loop. If blockers arise, DM me. Thanks all :thumbsup:

lee: Filed calendar ticket TKT-789 for rotation.

sasha: Runbook draft: https://go/redwood/runbooks/gpu-capacity-draft — please comment.

maria: Note: recurring risk window is 04:00-06:00 UTC (morning retrains). sasha, can you add a scheduled suppression suggestion (delay noncritical retrains by 2h)?

sasha: Will add that to the runbook.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly capacity triage meeting next Wed 09:00 UTC.

maria: If you own an action, reply with 'owner: <action>' so we can keep the checklist accurate.

tj: owner: emergency quota + reserved pool

devon: owner: scheduler tuning PR + tests

sasha: owner: runbook + PD checklist + rotation

lee: owner: PD automation + calendar ticket

maria: Thanks — will follow up in 72h.
